correctness.rationale: The Finding is true for all three independently labeled integer degrees at least two. The multiplier in output coordinate i after n steps is the ordered product along the coordinate cycle. For a cycle of the permutation in F^n, substituting forward fixes every coordinate except one from that one, and leaves T_D(x)=x with D the product of the cycle multipliers. The two grids of angles 2πr/(D-1), 2πs/(D+1) in [0,π] intersect at zero and also π exactly for odd D, yielding D roots. Multiplying over cycles gives B^n and hence the claimed zeta. In angle coordinates choose a disjoint deterministic branch-boundary tie partition from the B closed branch rectangles. All length-n itinerary atoms lie in their associated closed inverse-branch images, with sup-diameter at most 2^(-n). Thus the partition generates for every invariant measure, not only Lebesgue. The metric entropy is at most log B, with equality only for uniform iid labels, which determine the measure by generation. Lebesgue has exact cylinder probabilities B^(-n) (overlaps have volume zero), gives a one-sided shift isomorphism, and becomes the product arcsine measure. The variational principle gives the claimed topological entropy. The original explanation that exceptional branch boundaries have zero entropy is not a valid general justification in three dimensions: the invariant union of endpoint faces includes an F³ face subsystem with two free T_B coordinates. The all-measure tie-partition argument establishes the stated theorem without that explanation. Independence and cosine orthogonality give the displayed resonance, vanishing covariances at positive lag and labeled one-step recovery. The checker was inspected, not run; its finite identities are not the basis of the proof.

value.rationale: The contrast between abstract invariants and labeled observables is mathematically valid, but the family applies a scalar polynomial to just one input coordinate per output, with no competing or interacting terms. After the index permutation, the degree signature is exactly the orthogonality coefficient of the single basis polynomial already displayed in the map; even the complete lag formula evaluates one ancestor and one scalar equality. The metric classification is the standard full-branch coding on equally weighted rectangles, and the cycle census is direct forward substitution with the scalar count. The combination does not introduce an additional structural argument, a nonmechanical invariant, or an identification difficulty beyond these routine deductions. No separate substantive remainder justifies a repair.
